feats.name: Spellcasting
feats.text: Cast Wizard spells using Intelligence; cantrips, prepared spells and spell slots follow the class table. Slots come back on a Long Rest.

feats.name: Ritual Adept
feats.text: Cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a Ritual without preparing it. Ritual casting is not built.

feats.name: Arcane Recovery
feats.text: When you finish a Short Rest, recover spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up), none of level 6 or higher, once per Long Rest.

feats.name: Scholar
feats.text: Expertise in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature or Religion that you are proficient in.

feats.name: Evocation Savant
feats.text: Add two Evocation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feats.name: Potent Cantrip
feats.text: A damaging cantrip that misses or is saved against still deals half damage, with no other effect. The DM applies it.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for (the sheet's feats). Without one, the scores entered on the sheet are taken as they stand.

feats.name: Memorize Spell
feats.text: On a Short Rest, swap one prepared spell for another from your spellbook. Edit the sheet to change spells.

feats.name: Spellcasting
feats.text: Cast Cleric spells using Wisdom; cantrips, prepared spells and spell slots follow the class table. Slots come back on a Long Rest.

feats.name: Divine Order
feats.text: Choose Protector or Thaumaturge.

feats.name: Channel Divinity
feats.text: Uses of Channel Divinity (see the table) fuel Divine Spark, Turn Undead and your subclass's options; one comes back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Their save DC is your spell save DC.

feats.name: Divine Spark
feats.text: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity on another creature within 30 feet: roll the Divine Spark dice + Wisdom modifier, and either it regains that many Hit Points or it makes a Constitution save, taking that much Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) on a failure and half on a success.

feats.name: Turn Undead
feats.text: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity: each Undead within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute; it ends on a creature that takes damage, and on all if you are Incapacitated or die (applied). That a turned creature flees from you, and choosing to spare an Undead, are the DM's.

onFail.manual: Turn Undead: a turned creature tries to move as far from the cleric as it can on its turns.

feats.name: Disciple of Life
feats.text: A spell cast with a slot that restores Hit Points restores 2 + the slot's level more. The DM adds it.

feats.name: Preserve Life
feats.text: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity to share five times your Cleric level in Hit Points among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, none above half its maximum. The engine spends the use; the DM shares them out.

effects.manual: Preserve Life: share out Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet, none above half its Hit Point maximum.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
feats.text: Take the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for (the sheet's feats). Without one, the scores entered on the sheet are taken as they stand.

feats.name: Sear Undead
feats.text: Turn Undead also deals Radiant damage, Wisdom modifier d8s (at least one), rolled once, to each Undead that fails the save; this damage does not end the turning.

timeline.title: The old watchtower falls
timeline.text: A generation ago the watchtower north of the valley was abandoned. Its dead do not rest.

timeline.title: Goblins raid the east road
timeline.text: A goblin band with a tamed wolf took a merchant cart at dawn and camped east of the pond.
